title: Pointer advancement instruction
statement: For natural numbers $a,b,f$, a Boolean value $c$, and an index $i\in\mathbb{N}$, define the instruction to advance the pointer, remembering $c$, if $i=0$; if $i\ne0$, define it to test for the end of the scan, remembering $c$.
